# Golden generated games — the Generator contract of §5.6–5.8, frozen.
#
# One game per line, whitespace separated:
#   seed pieces cap  <ten board column words, 8 lowercase hex digits>  <sequence>
#
# Column word bit n is row 19-n, so bit 0 is the bottom row (§5.1). The sequence
# is one ASCII letter per piece, in the canonical order of §5.2.
#
# These two games are the pair the Playground and the page open on (seed 0) and
# the game every quick check uses (seed 42). They were first produced by an
# independent scratch port and agree with the §5.6 vectors and the board/sequence
# reported for seed 42 during exploration.
#
# seed pieces cap board                                                                                  sequence

42     40     7   00000000 0000001f 0000001f 00000004 00000064 00000050 0000007e 00000003 00000000 00000000 OJTISZLSTIZOLJSIZTJLOSTJILZOTZSLIOJISZLO
